mentions.name: Ordeal
mentions.description: A local-storage-only planning site that helps the user plan schedules ('ordeals'), installable as a progressive web app that works offline. Currently the entire ordeal can be moved as a whole; planned features include anchoring multiple fixed points so tasks in between stretch and shrink, and a moving horizontal line indicating the current time. Not yet optimized for phones.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Last thing I made was this semi-vibe-coded a local-storage-only site for helping myself plan stuff, I made so it works offline as a progressive web app too if you install it, but it's not suitable for phone at the moment, I don't know if I can be bothered to make it suitable for phone either..

https://dusted.dk/pages/ordeal/
